name: nabe
description: Self-hosted DNS control plane by KyleHub.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --if-present build && env -u APPIMAGE -u APPDIR cargo build --manifest-path apps/api/Cargo.toml
scripts.lint: pnpm -r --if-present lint && env -u APPIMAGE -u APPDIR cargo check --manifest-path apps/api/Cargo.toml
scripts.test: pnpm -r --if-present test && pnpm test:api && pnpm test:go
scripts.test:api: env -u APPIMAGE -u APPDIR cargo test --manifest-path apps/api/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:go: cd apps/speiche && go test ./... && cd ../cli && go test ./...
